guidance.bestFor: The plain default tone with just a title and a description line, no icon, color or buttons

whenNotToUse.when: A caution the reader must act on, tinted in the warning tone with a triangle
A confirmation that a task went through, tinted in the success tone

guidance.bestFor: A check mark in the leading column of a neutral card toned notice, with no color or actions

whenNotToUse.when: A check mark that should also tint the border and fill in the success color

name: c-alert-3
title: Alert with icon and action buttons
label: Icon & Actions
description: Alert with icon and action buttons

guidance.bestFor: The full row: shield icon, title, description and an outline Dismiss beside a solid Update button
agentNotes: Update is a `Button` with no click handler; point it at your password and 2FA settings

whenNotToUse.when: A one line prompt where the title alone carries the message

name: c-alert-4
title: Destructive alert with icon and action buttons
label: Payment Failure
description: Destructive alert with icon and action buttons

guidance.bestFor: A destructive payment failure whose description holds a bulleted checklist of details to fix

whenNotToUse.when: A short error message with no list of things to check
A payment failure the user must acknowledge before going on

name: c-alert-5
title: Info alert with icon and action buttons
label: Info Variant
description: Info alert with icon and action buttons

guidance.bestFor: The info variant with a tinted border, fill and circle icon for a notice worth reading closely

whenNotToUse.when: A notice that needs Dismiss and Update buttons beside its text

guidance.bestFor: The success variant with a check icon, confirming everything works and the user can carry on

whenNotToUse.when: A notice that a setting needs checking before the user moves on

guidance.bestFor: The warning variant with a triangle icon, pointing the user to settings or support

whenNotToUse.when: A neutral message with no warning tone or icon at all

guidance.bestFor: The destructive variant for a failed action, asking the user to try again or contact support

whenNotToUse.when: A caution that still lets the task go ahead, short of an error

guidance.bestFor: The invert variant: a dark solid bar with light text and a success colored icon for contrast

name: c-alert-10
title: Alert with icon and action buttons
label: Title & Actions
description: Alert with icon and action buttons

guidance.bestFor: A single title line paired with Dismiss and Update, leaving the description out entirely

whenNotToUse.when: A message longer than one line, which the title clamp would cut

name: c-alert-11
title: Alert with description and action buttons
label: Description & Actions
description: Alert with description and action buttons

guidance.bestFor: Muted body copy beside Dismiss and Update with no title above it, for one sentence prompts

whenNotToUse.when: A prompt that needs a title line above its sentence

name: c-alert-12
title: Alert integrated within a Frame with reset borders
label: Frame Reset Borders
description: Alert integrated within a Frame with reset borders

guidance.bestFor: A system update notice filling a Frame panel edge to edge, with a destructive tinted info icon and no actions
agentNotes: `FramePanel` loses its padding and `Alert` takes `border-0`, so the panel draws the only edge; keep both together

guidance.bestFor: A stacked Frame pair: a deploy success above a resource limit warning with a Verify button
agentNotes: The warning variant colors direct `svg` children itself, so the icon's `text-yellow-500` class changes nothing

name: c-alert-14
title: Alert with actions integrated within a Frame
label: Frame With Actions
description: Alert with actions integrated within a Frame

guidance.bestFor: A borderless default notice in a Frame panel with an emerald shield, a longer security message and 2 buttons

whenNotToUse.when: The same security prompt standing on its own, outside any Frame

guidance.bestFor: A Pro upsell on the dark invert variant, with a yellow bolt and a blue Upgrade button beside Dismiss
agentNotes: Upgrade is recolored with raw `bg-blue-500` and `text-white` classes, so it ignores your theme's primary color

guidance.bestFor: An expiring subscription notice in the destructive tint, with a credit card icon and a Renew Now button
agentNotes: The 3 day deadline is fixed text in `AlertDescription`; compute it from the real renewal date

whenNotToUse.when: An expiry notice that must stop the page until the user responds

name: c-alert-17
title: Service status summary stacked within a frame
label: Service Status
description: Service status summary stacked within a frame

guidance.bestFor: A 2 row service health summary, a connected database over an API latency warning with Retry, on clear fills
agentNotes: The last sync time and the US-East latency text are hardcoded in each `AlertDescription`; feed them from your status data

guidance.bestFor: A feature announcement on the info tint, with an icon only close button and an Explore features link below the copy
agentNotes: The `XIcon` close `Button` has no accessible name or handler; add an aria label and hide the alert from your state
Explore features is a link variant `Button` with no destination, so give it one

guidance.bestFor: A direct message notice with the sender's avatar, a one line quoted preview and View and Reply buttons
agentNotes: The `Avatar` is not an `svg`, so the root className sets a 32px first column by hand; resize both together
Swap the Unsplash `src` on `AvatarImage` and the hardcoded name and message for your own data

whenNotToUse.when: A mention notice on a dark inverted surface with a blue View button

guidance.bestFor: A comment mention on the dark invert surface, with avatar, dimmed action text and a blue View button
agentNotes: The leading column is sized only for a direct `svg`, so the `Avatar` relies on the custom grid columns in the `Alert` className
The `AvatarImage` photo, sender name and quoted comment are sample data to map from your notifications
View is painted with raw `bg-blue-500` and `text-white` classes that skip your theme tokens

whenNotToUse.when: A message notice on the default card surface with Reply beside View
